description: Rendering HTML on the server per request (`RenderMode.Server`).
Generating HTML at build time (`RenderMode.Prerender`), optionally for many params with `getPrerenderParams`.
Reusing server-rendered DOM in the browser instead of re-rendering it. Enabled with `provideClientHydration()`.
Captures user events before hydration and replays them once the app (or block) is ready.
Keeps `@defer` blocks dehydrated until a hydrate trigger (`hydrate on viewport`, `hydrate on interaction`, `hydrate never`...) fires.
Runs a callback in the browser only, after rendering; the safe place for browser APIs in SSR apps.
